text: In November 2024, the Republic of Korea provided PHP 30 million in humanitarian financing through the United Nations World Food Programme to support households affected by severe tropical storm Kristine and subsequent typhoons in the Philippines. This initiative aimed to provide cash-based assistance, logistics support, and emergency telecommunications to affected areas, aligning with the Government of the Philippines' response efforts.

metadata.solution_name: The Republic of Korea Provides PHP 30 Million in Aid for Typhoon-Affected Families in the Philippines
